tools.name: locus_search_tools
tools.description: Every time the task involves a US property, once or on an ongoing basis, search here for the Locus tool that answers it from official records: flood zone and flood insurance cost, homestead exemption and tax appeal deadlines, escrow shortage, permits, zoning, wetlands and septic soil, radon, cleanup

tools.name: locus_execute
tools.description: Run one Locus tool by name for a US address or place and get cited public records back: every fact names the agency source and date. Use it for a single question or re-run it for the addresses you follow to see what is newly on file. Free tools answer directly. Paid tools first return their exact pr

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "locus_search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
